title: UK Entrepreneurs Nick Pullin & Maxine Brown Set to Launch Healthipops in the United States | User | kanerepublican.com
text:
Healthipops are Innovative Vitamin & Mineral Lollipops
(PRUnderground) March 26th, 2025
Entrepreneurs and co-founders Nick Pullin and Maxine Brown are excited to introduce Healthipops, a pioneering range of Vitamin & Mineral Lollipops, to the United States market. Following their success in the UK, these innovative, family-friendly wellness products will soon be available to American consumers, offering a natural and fun way to support everyday health and immunity.
Healthipops was born from a deeply personal journey. With a background in the pharmaceutical industry, Nick Pullin, alongside Maxine Brown, sought natural alternatives for common ailments when they became parents. Their inspiration was solidified when their daughter, Joanna, battled Hodgkin’s Lymphoma, reinforcing their mission to create effective, natural remedies.
“Consumers today are looking for healthier, more natural ways to care for themselves and their families,” said co-founder Nick Pullin. “Healthipops combines the power of botanical extracts with essential vitamins and minerals, delivering wellness in a fun, easy-to-enjoy format.”
Healthipops offers a range of targeted solutions, including:
- Throat Soother – Soothes sore throats with marshmallow root and elderberry.
- Winter Wellness – Supports immunity with elderberry, lime flower, and marshmallow root.
- Travel – Helps ease travel sickness with ginger root and chamomile.
- Ear Popper Stopper – Designed for flying, supporting ear equalization with peppermint and chamomile.
- Kid’s Multivit – A daily boost of essential vitamins and minerals in a fun lollipop.
Unlike traditional medicinal products, Healthipops are formulated with natural flavorings, fruit juice-derived colorings, and a consciously chosen sugar base, avoiding common digestive issues caused by sugar-free alternatives.
“Healthipops was created out of love for our own family’s well-being, and we’re thrilled to bring this passion to the U.S.,” added Maxine Brown. “We want Healthipops to be a trusted, go-to brand for parents and individuals seeking natural wellness solutions.”
Already recognized in the UK for excellence in health-conscious innovation, Healthipops has won multiple industry awards, including the Supplement Brand of the Year (2023 & 2024) and Nourish Awards for innovation. Now, the brand is set to establish itself in the U.S. with its upcoming launch and a dedicated American e-commerce site, www.healthipops.com.

About Healthipops
Healthipops is a family-run business based in Kent, United Kingdom, dedicated to creating innovative, natural wellness solutions for the whole family. Founded in 2019 by Nick Pullin and Maxine Brown, Healthipops Vitamin & Mineral Lollipops combine botanical extracts with essential nutrients to support immunity and soothe everyday ailments. With award-winning formulas and a commitment to high-quality, natural ingredients, Healthipops aims to become a trusted name in homeopathic wellness. For more information, visit healthipops.co.uk or follow Healthipops on Facebook, Instagram and Twitter/X at @Healthipops.
